artifacts.notes: The PDF contains an ABBYY FineReader 9.0 OCR layer, but it is a restricted nonretained artifact and is not registered as indexable text. Boundary pages were inspected for the page-445 Index notification and the Perfectae caritatis (pp. 702-712), Nostra aetate (pp. 740-744), Dei Verbum (pp. 817-835), appended conciliar Notificatio (p. 836), Dignitatis humanae (pp. 929-946), Ad gentes (pp. 947-990), Presbyterorum ordinis (pp. 991-1024), and Gaudium et spes (pp. 1025-1120) constituents. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
